dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, Baizhu isn't in his shop...

dialogues.speaker: Pedestrian at Pharmacy Entrance
dialogues.text: Oh, you're looking for Dr. Baizhu? He's resting today, but he said to send any patients to the back room.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, okay! Thanks! We'll head on through.
